Vijay's 'Jana Nayagan' Sees Strong Box Office Recovery

The action film earned Rs 28.50 crore India net on its first Saturday, bringing the three-day India net collection close to Rs 100 crore. Worldwide gross collections for the movie have now reached Rs 17 crore. The performance is attributed to a strong opening day of Rs 4.95 crore and a weekend surge that saw it earn an additional ₹107 crore in India. The film's box office recovery has been steady, with its first-day collection at Rs 1.82 crore.
